definitions.explanation: A person who moves to live permanently in a foreign country.
The act of moving to a foreign country to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移民|いみん}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His grandfather was an immigrant to America.

examples.japanese: {移民|いみん}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}する→議論：02650_giron⟧。
⟦カナダ→カナダ：30077_kanada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移民|いみん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: There are many immigrants in this town.

examples.japanese: {移民|いみん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: To start a new life in a new country as an immigrant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{移民|いみん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧20⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My family immigrated when I was young, and it's been 20 years now.

notes:
{移民|いみん} means both the person (immigrant/emigrant) and the act (immigration/emigration). It can be used with する as a verb.

FORMS:
{移|い} (move) + {民|みん} (people)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {移民|いみん}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: immigration policy
- {移民|いみん}⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧: immigration visa
- ⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧{移民|いみん}: illegal immigrant
- {移民|いみん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept immigrants
- 〜に{移民|いみん}する: to immigrate to ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {移民|いみん}: immigrant (voluntary relocation)
- ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧: refugee (forced displacement)
- ⟦{帰化|きか}→帰化：19840_kika⟧: naturalization (becoming a citizen)

ETYMOLOGY:
Japan has a history of {移民|いみん} to Brazil, Hawaii, and the Americas in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
